description: Creates an order from a valid quote and returns a payment URL (hosted payment page, tax handled) and the secret order_token. Nothing is charged by this call: the buyer pays on the returned URL. Calling again with the same idempotency_key and quote returns the same order. Both accept_terms and immediate_delivery_waiver must be true, only after the buyer agreed.

accept_terms.description: True: the buyer accepts the licence terms

buyer_entity.description: Company or organisation to print on the licence

idempotency_key.description: Random string of 16-128 characters chosen by the caller, reused when retrying

immediate_delivery_waiver.description: True: the buyer wants immediate delivery of the digital content and waives any withdrawal right

name: create_order
title: Create an order and its payment link
